title: Sleep beneath the Northern Lights
description: Spend several nights at a remote aurora-viewing lodge, preferably with heated indoor viewing or an aurora-facing room. Waiting for the sky to come alive is the experience; several nights improve the chances.
teaser: Spend several nights at a remote aurora-viewing lodge, preferably with heated indoor viewing or an aurora-facing room.
goodToKnow: Aurora season extends through April. Weather and sightings are never guaranteed.
